correctness.rationale: A unit normalized Gaussian is Haar-uniform on the circle, so z=u^T A u/lambda has the arcsine distribution for every conjugate of diag(lambda,-lambda). The exact Frobenius identity is 2lambda²-2lambda² d psi+lambda^4 psi². Its arc-sine integral gives J(x)=1/(x sqrt(1+x²)); differentiation yields the risk curve and factorized derivative with unique minimum at 1/sqrt(2). Hard cutoff integrates independently on retained/rejected angular sectors, with a unique minimum of 1+2/pi. Completed square yields the scalar oracle 3/2; inverse-core moment integrability holds iff p<1. Exact symbolic identities, rational matrix arithmetic and angular quadrature were independently computed by the packaged verifier. The finite checks are ancillary to the displayed analytic proof; no unproved general-dimensional claim is made.

value.rationale: The smallest balanced indefinite signature realizes severe cancellation in a Nyström sketched core, a directly documented numerical-stability problem. The exact optimized Tikhonov risk and strict improvement against even the best thresholded pseudoinverse settle a natural soft-versus-hard inverse-design decision quantitatively, while the 3/2 scalar-oracle benchmark identifies remaining avoidable error. The two-dimensional rotationally invariant one-probe model is canonical for this obstruction, rather than an arbitrary cherry-picked entrywise matrix. The result is usable as a scale-calibrated benchmark but does not pretend to control general matrices or implementation errors.
